hits.draft_en:
"Maybe beyond what a human could have come up with, but not beyond human understanding."

That second half is the whole job.

If your agent does something clever and nobody on your team can explain it, you don't have automation. You have a mystery with a license fee.

This week in Copilot Studio:

1. Open your agent's Activity tab
2. Read 10 real runs, not test chats
3. Write one sentence per run on why it did what it did

Can't write the sentence? Fix the instructions before you add a feature.

hits.draft_en:
GitHub just made secret scanning 86% faster and 11.5% more accurate.

Meanwhile, somewhere in your tenant, a Power Automate flow has an API key pasted into an HTTP action. In plain text. Since 2022.

3 fixes for this week:

1. Move it to an environment variable of type Secret, backed by Azure Key Vault
2. Turn on Secure inputs and Secure outputs on that action so run history stops showing it
3. Run Solution checker before every export

Pick one and do it before Friday.

drafts.rides: @code configurable eagerness + Josh's Copilot Code post (9,582 views)
drafts.text:
VS Code now lets you set how eager Copilot is. Low, Medium, or High.

I want this slider everywhere.

Copilot in Outlook: Low. Please stop finishing my passive aggressive emails.
Copilot in Excel at 4:55 PM on a Friday: High.
Copilot in Power Automate: High, but show me the expression before you save it.

One model, three modes, and you pick. That's the right default for every agent you ship.

What's your setting?
drafts.video_tip: 15s split screen: same line of code typed with eagerness Low vs High, ghost text size growing. End card with a dial labelled Outlook / Excel / Power Automate.

drafts.rides: Outsider meta: Graphify 'map once, not grep forever' (102,299 views) + Skills for Real Engineers (6,029 views)
drafts.text:
The two biggest agent repos in my feed this weekend have the same idea.

Give the agent context once. Stop re-explaining it every prompt.

Graphify maps the codebase once instead of grepping forever. Skills files teach the agent your playbook in one folder.

Copilot Studio people, you already have this. It's called Instructions plus Knowledge.

If you're still pasting the same 400 word prompt into every chat, move it into the agent's Instructions today and point Knowledge at one SharePoint library.
drafts.video_tip: Before/after 30s: left side, someone pasting a giant prompt into chat for the 5th time; right side, the same text living in the agent's Instructions box and a SharePoint library added under Knowledge. Overlay: 'Map once. Stop grepping your own brain.'
